what_it_does: Improves iterative solvers for sparse linear systems (a fundamental computational kernel in scientific computing) by mixing half-precision 16-bit floating point with full double-precision 64-bit arithmetic. Half-precision is faster and uses less memory but is less accurate. The method nests the Flexible Generalized Minimum Residual (FGMRES) method inside a Richardson iterative method, with inner solvers running in low-precision to save bandwidth while outer solvers guarantee overall convergence.
